# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 73 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 73

Jesus said: "The harvest is great but the laborers are few. Beseech the Lord to send laborers into the harvest."

---

**Council Notes:**

- One of the clearest Q parallels in Thomas (Matt 9:37-38; Luke 10:2). Minor differences: Thomas lacks "of the harvest" after "Lord."
- "Laborers" (EMET) over "workers" (LOGOS/PNEUMA): the Coptic *ergate* carries the full sense of agricultural laborers, which "workers" dilutes.
- "Beseech" (EMET) over "pray" (LOGOS) or "ask" (PNEUMA): the intensity of petition is appropriate here.
- Thomas's omission of "of the harvest" after Lord is significant: it makes the saying more universally theological.
